content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Project Attendant (Admn/Tech) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) for project-based contractual positions in Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Project Attendant (Admn/Tech) under advertisement number BMG-3102-HSD/26-27 for the current hiring cycle.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Attendant (Admn/Tech) position under this specific notification released by IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for Project Attendant?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a 12th pass qualification, or a 10th pass with 2 years of experience, or an 8th pass with 4 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for IIT Roorkee Project Attendant?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Attendant (Admn/Tech) position will receive a monthly salary ranging between Rs. 15,000 and Rs. 30,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The applications are to be submitted via Email. Candidates need to send their bio-data and necessary documents to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for IIT Roorkee Project Attendant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the complete application via email is 10-10-2026. Applicants should ensure timely submission before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates applying for this position. The application fee is Nil for all categories.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIT Roorkee Project Attendant?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an Interview followed by Document Verification for shortlisted candidates based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q10. What is the expected date of joining after selection?
faq.answer: The expected date of joining for the selected candidate for the Project Attendant (Admn/Tech) position is 01-12-2026.
